game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Moonstone Terrace, a terrace of moonstone: the relic hunter must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Moonstone Terrace: a terrace of moonstone
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Expression order: declare resource as int, apply (resource + 11) * 4, and print each result with %d. Dataset 5 starts with [-3, 0, 11, 14]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stack Of Plates' (Week 7 slot 5), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Moonstone Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Reach the heart stone using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The heart stone reached with actions_used <= 21.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the heart stone is reached, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Stack Of Plates – Moonstone Terrace Trial
hint: Declare before use. int resource = readInput(); creates the named game-port value; printf uses %d.
